CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Create a new custom wishlist from the wishlist page
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open the wishlist page and use the + action to create a new named wishlist. Confirm it appears in the wishlist selector/navigation.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
A new wishlist is created with the entered name.
The new list is selectable immediately.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: From the wishlist navigation, trigger rename/edit for a custom list, submit a new name, and refresh the page.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The new wishlist name persists after save.
No stale name appears after refresh.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Remove a custom wishlist using the remove modal flow
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open remove action from wishlist navigation, confirm deletion in modal, and verify list is no longer available.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The selected wishlist is removed.
User remains in a stable post-delete state without UI errors.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Use wishlist navigation controls/icons to switch or manage lists
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Verify create/edit/remove controls are visible in expected contexts and switch between all-items and single-list views.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Controls are visible in the correct context.
Navigation updates content for the selected view.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Add item to wishlist from PDP or MiniPDP when user has multiple lists
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: On PDP and MiniPDP, open add-to-wishlist control and choose a specific wishlist. Then verify item appears in chosen list.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Control exposes wishlist choice when multiple lists exist.
Item is added to the intended wishlist.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Validate all-items view and per-list filtering behavior
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open wishlist all-items view, then filter to specific lists and compare item counts/list membership.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
All-items view renders combined entries.
Filtering isolates expected list items without stale data.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Ensure login flow preserves multi-wishlist intent
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: While logged out, attempt a wishlist action that requires auth; complete login and verify intended wishlist action can be completed.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
After login, user is returned to a valid wishlist context.
Action can be completed without losing intent.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Validate redirect behavior for users with exactly one wishlist
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Login with a single-wishlist account and enter wishlist via navigation entry point.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
User lands directly on the only wishlist.
No unnecessary list selector step is shown.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Delete an item from multiple wishlists context and verify effect
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: From all-items view, delete a product associated with multiple wishlists and review list states.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Deletion applies to the intended multi-list context.
Removed item no longer appears where expected.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Undo a multi-wishlist item removal and validate modal/API error handling
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Trigger item deletion and immediate undo; also force/observe backend error path for create/rename on MRP to validate user message.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Undo restores the item associations correctly.
Error message is clear and user can recover/retry.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Delete/Undo behavior across multiple wishlists can regress as list-item relationships change.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Add the same SKU into at least two custom wishlists and All Items. Delete from All Items, verify removal from all linked lists, then trigger Undo immediately and verify restoration in each list.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Delete removes the SKU from all intended list contexts; Undo restores prior list associations without duplication, stale counters, or ghost entries.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: PR #825 (G2-22969) and PR #845 (G2-23030) in mytheresa/atelier indicate recent high-change surface for relationship consistency.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: MRP-specific backend error-message behavior for create/rename requires explicit cross-brand check.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: In MRP acceptance, attempt create/rename with a duplicated list name and with an invalid/edge input. Capture modal error text and recovery path, then compare with NAP behavior for equivalent steps.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: MRP shows clear, non-duplicated error text, modal remains recoverable, and user can retry/cancel without losing context.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: PR #776 (G2-23730) targets duplicated default wishlist name error text, so wording and recovery should be regression-checked.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Auth handoff during wishlist actions may regress with session transitions.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: From PDP and MiniPDP while logged out, initiate add-to-wishlist, complete login, and verify post-login continuation preserves the selected target wishlist and pending user intent.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: No dropped intent, no duplicate adds, and user lands in a valid wishlist context with expected selector state.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: No direct PR key hit found for G2-20842 in mytheresa/atelier; keep this as a high-priority exploratory continuity check.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Wishlist navigation state can desync across icon actions, truncation/collapse behavior, and single-list redirect.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Verify create/edit icon visibility by context, long-title truncation and collapse behavior on smaller breakpoints, and direct redirect for single-wishlist accounts from nav entry points.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Navigation controls remain context-correct, long names do not break layout, and single-list users bypass unnecessary selection steps.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: PR #559 (G2-19105), PR #598 (G2-22343), and PR #778 (G2-23523) indicate related navigation behavior areas that should be validated together.
